text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sweden says it will drop donor conditions to aid provided to Zaire, in an effort to encourage better relations with donor-dependent African countries.
- The Irish embassy urged the Lusaka government to consult various stakeholders before pushing through controversial media reforms.
- Four Zambians drowned in the Zambezi river.
- Over 100 soldiers from the special presidential guard of embattled Zairean president Mobuto Sese Seko have fled into Zambia.
- President Frederick Chiluba is to go to Tanzania for a one-day regional summit on the situation in Burundi.
- The farmers' union had projected a three percent drop in maize output in 1997.
- The law association of Zambia says it will conduct a prison audit to establish why over-crowding is increasing in the country's jails.
